title: DNP3 / IEC-104 / OPC UA / other ICS exposure (no write/control)
description: Active identification of DNP3, IEC-104, OPC UA, Schneider, GE, OMRON, Mitsubishi, etc.; no control.
detail: Authorized, in-scope. **Active + read/identify allowed; NO WRITE/CONTROL/ACTUATION.** 1) **DNP3** tcp/20000 (dnp3-info) — identify outstation/master info; **no operate/direct-operate/select-before-operate, no writes/control**. 2) **IEC-104** tcp/2404 — identify exposure/services; no command/actuation (no C_SC/C_DC/C_RC/C_SE). 3) **OPC UA** tcp/4840 — enumerate endpoints/security (anon/cert/auth), browse/read attributes for assessment; **no method calls that actuate, no writes to process variables**. 4) **Schneider Modicon** (Modbus/UMAS 502) — identify/read-only (see Modbus/UMAS). 5) **GE SRTP** 18245, **OMRON FINS** udp/9600, **Mitsubishi MELSEC** 5007/5006, **Codesys** 2455, **PCWorx** 1962, **Triconex** 1502, **Red Lion Crimson** 789, **PROFINET** discovery — identify/fingerprint read-only. 6) Report internet/IT-reachable ICS exposure as high risk; verify segmentation. Never send control/write operations.
